test_type: Full-image vs single-crop vs multi-crop comparison

findings.description: Text content inside the bordered container extends past the right edge and is clipped.

repair_recommendation.summary: Allow text to wrap or expand container width
repair_recommendation.suggested_action: Remove strict width constraints or enable text wrapping using CSS properties like word-wrap or flex adjustments.
repair_recommendation.rationale: Enables the full text to remain readable without being cut off by the container boundary.

findings.description: The text inside the red-bordered container is clipped and overflows past the right border of the fixed container box.

repair_recommendation.summary: Allow container to wrap text or adjust dimensions
repair_recommendation.suggested_action: Remove fixed height/width constraints or allow overflow wrapping (e.g., word-wrap, overflow: visible) to prevent text clipping.
repair_recommendation.rationale: Ensures all text remains fully visible and readable within its container.

findings.description: Text inside the bounded container is clipped or extends beyond the right border of the red-outlined box, causing truncation of the text string.

repair_recommendation.summary: Adjust container dimensions or text wrapping
repair_recommendation.suggested_action: Increase the width of the container or allow text wrapping and proper overflow handling so all text remains visible.
repair_recommendation.rationale: Ensures that content fits inside its container without being clipped by fixed boundaries.

findings.description: The product preview image is failing to load, displaying only the broken image icon and alternative text.

repair_recommendation.summary: Fix or replace the broken image source
repair_recommendation.suggested_action: Verify the image file path or URL and ensure the resource is accessible.
repair_recommendation.rationale: Correcting the image source will allow the graphic to render properly instead of showing a broken image placeholder.

findings.description: The product preview image is broken, displaying a missing image icon alongside the 'Product preview' alt text.

repair_recommendation.summary: Fix or replace the broken image source
repair_recommendation.suggested_action: Verify the image file path or URL and update the 'src' attribute to point to a valid resource.
repair_recommendation.rationale: Ensures the product preview image renders correctly for users instead of showing a broken image placeholder.

findings.description: The product preview image is failing to load, displaying the alt text 'Product preview' with a broken image icon instead of the actual graphic resource.

repair_recommendation.summary: Fix the broken image source URL or restore the image asset
repair_recommendation.suggested_action: Verify and correct the image file path or URL in the markup.
repair_recommendation.rationale: Correcting the source attribute will allow the image to load successfully and display the intended visual content to users.
